summary: Vision-OCR of the two largest modern gaps, **Winter 1995** and **Winter 1996**, ran 24 Sep – 7 Oct 2026 on subscription quota (Gemini via the Antigravity CLI, GPT-6-Sol via the Codex CLI) and then stopped: the runner processes were killed while paused for a quota reset. Everything read so far was banked on 7 Nov 2026 (**+664,418 entries, 273,068 existing rows corrected**). **831 PDF pages remain** across the two editions — about one week of both subscriptions' quota at the measured rate (~700 + ~380 pages/week).
